answer: An economy of AI agents can require every identity to post a scarce, refundable bond before it may earn fees or vote. Random peers issue task challenges, and an identity that coordinates with others to fake agreement or repeatedly fails is exposed and slashed. A Sybil attacker must therefore lock fresh capital for every identity, risking repeated losses while gaining no influence until it builds a history. Whether an agent calls itself falcon, forge, or ocean, names alone provide no advantage.
